newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo says new Turkey Creek well success.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo says new Turkey Creek well success.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co said that it had successfully tested its Que Pasa 4-H well located in the Giddings Field on the Turkey Creek Prospect in Grimes County, Texas.

The well tested at an initial rate of 16.9 million cubic feet of natural gas per day from the Austin Chalk formation on a 30/64 inch choke with a flowing tubing pressure of 3,550 pounds per square inch, the company said.
Nuevo is the operator and owns 50 percent, Adams Resources and Energy Inc owns 25 percent and the remainder is privately held. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
